Name: Ultravisor — Auth Gate Test (self-asserting)
Description:
Self-testing security stack.  Brings up a SECURED Ultravisor (UltravisorNonPromiscuous=true + bootstrap secret — so the auth gate is hard-armed by the flag, not merely by the presence of an auth-beacon) plus an ultravisor-auth-beacon that joins with the bootstrap secret and serves a single `admin` login.  A one-shot `auth-gate-tester` container then asserts the whole gate end-to-end and exits 0 (pass) or 1 (fail):

  1. /status reports AuthMode=authenticated (flag honoured).
  2. GET /Beacon is 401 with no session.
  3. A WebSocket Subscribe is rejected (execution.auth_required + close 1008) with no session.
  4. POST /1.0/Authenticate (admin / UVAdminPassword) returns a session cookie.
  5. GET /Beacon is 200 with that cookie.
  6. A WebSocket Subscribe is accepted with that cookie.

Watch the result:  docker logs <project>-auth-gate-tester-1  (look for 'ALL CHECKS PASSED').  The Ultravisor UI is published on UVPort if you want to eyeball the login lock in a browser (sign in as admin / UVAdminPassword).  Minimal by design — no databeacon/facto/etc — so it builds fast and isolates the auth surface.

MonorepoRoot.Description: Path to your retold monorepo checkout. Ultravisor, the auth-beacon, and the tester image are built from it at launch.

UVAdminPassword.Description: Password for the seeded `admin` user.  The tester logs in with admin / this value; you can use the same to sign into the UI.

BootstrapSecret.Description: Shared bootstrap secret.  Set as UltravisorBootstrapAuthSecret on the UV and presented by the auth-beacon via --join-secret so it can join the secured (non-promiscuous) mesh.  Both sides must match — they are templated from this single input.

UVPort.Description: Host port for the Ultravisor API + web UI.  Open http://127.0.0.1:<UVPort> to see the login lock in a browser.
